angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,935,131 km at 83.63 pc = 0.31 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 11.9576 +/- 0.0254 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 83.63 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 2.782 (2.723 to 2.842) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 1,935,131 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.070 (1.025 to 1.110) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4888 +/- 19.1 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 603083781399095936: teff_gspphot 4887.84 K (16th-84th percentiles 4865.079-4903.285), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 603083781399095936: teff_gspphot 4887.84 K (16th-84th percentiles 4865.079-4903.285), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/gakyid.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.579, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 73534 (pscomppars): spectral type G5, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 73534: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 73534 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.232 dex, from Valenti et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...702..989V/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 73534 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.522, from Valenti et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...702..989V/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 73534 (pscomppars): age 7.04 Gyr, from Ment et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..213M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 73534 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1 km/s, from Valenti et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009ApJ...702..989V/abstract)
